candidate_tools.name: get_issue
candidate_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.

candidate_tools.name: list_issues
candidate_tools.description: Browse issues filtered by status and/or assignee. Use for structured listing; use search_issues to find issues by text in title or body, and get_issue for one known ID. Returns at most 50 issues unless limit is set. Comments are included by default, so set include_comments=false for smaller responses.

include_comments.description: Whether each returned issue includes its comments. Defaults to true when omitted; set false to reduce response size.

status.description: Filter by issue status. One of: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. Any other value returns an error. Omit to include all statuses.

candidate_tools.name: search_issues
candidate_tools.description: Find issues by case-insensitive text match against title and body. Use when you have keywords; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee, and get_issue for one known ID. Has no limit parameter and returns all matches, with comments included by default; set include_comments=false for smaller responses.
